lines: SGLang returns input_token_logprobs aligned to ids[logprob_start_len:] with None in front (no logits before
the first scored position), so start one token earlier and drop that entry.
+        The cache is flushed first (as in Miles' own prefill log-prob recomputation): on this
+        hybrid linear-attention model, scoring with a warm prefix cache returns log-probs from
+        the restored recurrent-state path, which we measured to differ from a fresh forward by
+        ~0.02/token on average (outliers > 1 nat), while a cold prefill matches generation
+        log-probs to ~0.001/token. These scores drive the sampler's accept/reject and become
+        the injected sample's rollout log-probs, so they must be the fresh-forward values the
+        trainer will compute. Callers must therefore not run other engine requests concurrently
+        (the flush needs an idle engine); the rescue processes groups sequentially for this reason.
assert start >= 1, "need at least one context token"
